svg.text: Skill and bar: why the same lower bar hurts more on hard problems
A drawing of the idea, not measured data. Each curve shows how correct a group of answers looks to the judge.
Right and wrong answers look very different.
the judge chooses answers to the right of its bar
Wrong picks with the ISO bar: about 6 in 100
Extra wrong picks with the lower bar: about 8 in 100
The bar moves by the same amount in both drawings.
Right and wrong answers look almost the same.
the judge chooses answers to the right of its bar
Wrong picks with the ISO bar: about 43 in 100
Extra wrong picks with the lower bar: about 19 in 100
The bar moves by the same amount in both drawings.
